content: The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) provided funding for the development of the updated 2016 WHO guidelines on the treatment of drug-resistant tuberculosis. These guidelines were formulated based on discussions held by an ad hoc Guideline Development Group (GDG) convened by the WHO Global TB Programme (GTB) in Geneva, Switzerland, from November 9 to 11, 2015. The WHO acknowledges the contributions of the GDG members, including Holger Schünemann (Chair and GRADE methodologist), Charles L. Daley (Co-Chair), and other experts such as Farhana Amanullah, Jose A. Caminero, Tsira Chakhaiya, Daniela Cirillo, Kelly Dooley, Luis Gustavo Do Valle Bastos, Michel Gasana, Agnes Gebhard, Armen Hayrapetyan, Antonia Kwiecien, Sundari Mase, Lindsay McKenna, Nguyen Viet Nhung, Maria Rodriguez, James Seddon, Tom Shinnick, Alena Skrahina, and Carlos Torres-Duque. The External Review Group (ERG) also provided comments during the preparation of the meeting and on the draft document before its finalization. Members of the ERG included Chen-Yuan Chiang, Vaira Leimane, Guy Marks, Norbert Ndjeka, Lee Reichman, Rohit Sarin, and Dalene Von Delft. The writing of the guidelines was coordinated by Dennis Falzon and Elizabeth Harauz (Consultant), under the guidance and supervision of Ernesto Jaramillo and Karin Weyer, with overall direction from Mario Raviglione, Director of the GTB. The WHO also acknowledges the contributions of its staff involved in the production of the guidelines, including members of the WHO Guideline Steering Committee: Nathan Ford, Giuliano Gargioni, Haileyesus Getahun, Malgorzata Grzemska, Avinash Kanchar, Soleil Labelle, Christian Lienhardt, Knut Lönnroth, Fuad Mirzayev, Linh Nhat Nguyen, Marco Antonio Vitoria, Fraser Wares, Diana Weil, and Matteo Zignol. Additionally, WHO staff from regional offices reviewed the final draft of the guidelines, including Masoud Dara (Europe), Mirtha Del Granado (Americas), Daniel Kibuga (Africa), Hyder Khurshid (South-East Asia), Mohammed Abdel Aziz (Eastern Mediterranean), and Nobuyuki Nishikiori (Western Pacific). The finalized document underwent an iterative process of comments in early 2016 from GDG members, ERG members, and the WHO Guideline Steering Committee before submission to the WHO Guideline Review Committee (GRC) in March 2016, following WHO’s internal clearance process. The funding for this update was made available through the USAID-WHO Consolidated Grant No. GHA-G-00-09-00003/US-2014-735. The 2017 update of the guidelines for the treatment of drug-susceptible tuberculosis and patient care was also developed by a GDG convened by the WHO GTB in Geneva, Switzerland, from July 11 to 13, 2016. Holger Schünemann (GRADE Methodologist) chaired the GDG meeting, which synthesized and evaluated evidence to revise the guidance document. Experts who contributed to the GDG included Si Thu Aung, Frank Bonsu, Jeremiah Chakaya, Lucy Chesire, Daniela Cirillo, Poonam Dhavan, Kelly Dooley, Kathy Fiekert, Mike Frick, Andrei Maryandyshev, Nguyen Viet Nhung, Ejaz Qadeer, Abdul Hamid Salim, Simon Schaaf, Pedro Suarez, Carrie Tudor, and Justin Wong Yun Yaw. The WHO expresses gratitude to institutions such as the University of California, San Francisco; McGill University in Montreal, Canada; The University of Sydney, Australia; Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Baltimore, USA; and the University of British Columbia, Vancouver, Canada, for their collaboration in preparing and presenting evidence profiles for the GDG meeting. External reviewers who provided feedback on the completed document included Riitta Dlodo, Celine Garfin, Vaira Leimane, Lee Reichman, Rohit Sarin, Dalene Von Delft, and Fraser Wares. The writing of these guidelines was coordinated by Giuliano Gargioni, Linh Nguyen, and Elizabeth Harauz, under the guidance of Malgorzata Grzemska and with overall direction from Mario Raviglione, Director of GTB. The WHO acknowledges the contributions of its staff participating in the WHO Guideline Steering Committee, which provided technical guidance throughout the development process, including Dennis Falzon, Ernesto Jaramillo, Avinash Kanchar, Soleil Labelle, Christian Lienhardt, Knut Lönnroth, Nicola Magrini, Fuad Mirzayev, Marco Vitoria, Diana Weil, Karin Weyer, and Matteo Zignol. The document was finalized following an iteration of comments in late 2016 from GDG members, external reviewers, and the WHO Guideline Steering Committee, ahead of submission to the WHO Guidelines Review Committee in January 2017 as part of WHO’s internal clearance process. The WHO thanks USAID for its financial support through the USAID-WHO grants US-2015-823 and US-2015-827. The contents of this publication do not necessarily reflect the views of USAID or the United States Government.
